```{r, include=F} 
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)

library(kableExtra)
library(tidyr)

```



```{r, echo = F}
#### Reading and Combining Results Across Simulations ####
files <- list.files(path = "Project 4/Data", pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

all_results <- map_dfr(files, function(f){
  data <- readRDS(f)
  
  # Extract filename only
  fname <- basename(f)
  
  # Pull simulation number
  sim_id <- str_extract(fname, "\\d{3}(?=\\.rds)") %>%
    as.numeric()
  
  # Pull n
  n_val <- str_extract(fname, "(?<=sim_n)\\d+") %>%
    as.numeric()
  
  # Pull rho
  rho_val <- str_extract(fname, "(?<=rho)\\d+") %>%
    as.numeric() / 100
  
  data$sim_id <- sim_id
  data$file_n <- n_val
  data$file_rho <- rho_val
  
  data
})


# Sanity check of results
# 20 variables x 7 methods x 1000 sims = 140000 results for each sample size and each correlation value
table(all_results$file_n, all_results$file_rho)

```



```{r, echo = F}
#### Performance Metrics Calculations ####

# TPR, FPR, FNR and TNR across models
confusion_summary <- all_results %>%
  mutate(TP = ifelse(true_non_zero == 1 & selected == 1, 1, 0),
         FN = ifelse(true_non_zero == 1 & selected == 0, 1, 0),
         FP = ifelse(true_non_zero == 0 & selected == 1, 1, 0),
         TN = ifelse(true_non_zero == 0 & selected == 0, 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(method, n, rho) %>%
  summarise(TPR = sum(TP) / (sum(TP) + sum(FN)),
            FNR = sum(FN) / (sum(TP) + sum(FN)),
            FPR = sum(FP) / (sum(FP) + sum(TN)),
            TNR = sum(TN) / (sum(FP) + sum(TN)),
            .groups = "drop")


confusion_wide <- confusion_summary %>%
  mutate(across(TPR:TNR, ~ round(.x * 100, 1))) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = rho,
              values_from = c(TPR, FNR, FPR, TNR)) %>%
  arrange(n, method) %>%
  select(-n)

confusion_wide %>%
  kable(booktabs = TRUE,
        digits = 1,
        align = "lcccccccccccc",
        col.names = c("Method", "TPR", "FNR", "FPR", "TNR", "TPR", "FNR", "FPR", "TNR", "TPR", "FNR", "FPR", "TNR")) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "$\\rho$ = 0" = 4, "$\\rho$ = 0.35" = 4, "$\\rho$ = 0.70" = 4 )) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center", latex_options = c("hold_position", "striped")) %>%
  pack_rows("n = 250", 1, 7) %>%
  pack_rows("n = 500", 8, 14)

```




```{r, echo = F}
# Bias and Coverage of Variables Selected

bias_data <- all_results %>%
  mutate(bias = estimate - true_values)

true_table <- bias_data %>%
  filter(true_non_zero == 1) %>%
  group_by(method, n, rho, variables) %>%
  summarise(
    bias = mean(bias[selected == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    coverage = mean(covered[selected == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    selected_rate = mean(selected),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cell = case_when(
      selected_rate == 0 ~ "-",
      is.nan(bias) ~ "-",
      TRUE ~ paste0(round(bias, 3), " (", round(coverage, 2), ")")
    ),
    n_rho = paste0("rho = ", rho)
  ) %>%
  select(method, n, n_rho, variables, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(n, n_rho),
    values_from = cell
  )

true_table %>%
  kable(
    booktabs = TRUE,
    caption = "Bias (Coverage) for True Predictors (X1–X5)",
    align = "lcccccc"
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(c(
    " " = 2,
    "n = 250" = 3,
    "n = 500" = 3
  )) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  pack_rows(index = table(true_table$method))


false_table <- bias_data %>%
  filter(true_non_zero == 0) %>%
  group_by(method, n, rho, variables) %>%
  summarise(
    bias = mean(bias[selected == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    coverage = mean(covered[selected == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    selected_rate = mean(selected),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cell = ifelse(
      selected_rate == 0,
      "-",
      paste0(round(bias, 3), " (", round(coverage, 2), ")")
    ),
    n_rho = paste0("rho = ", rho)
  ) %>%
  select(method, n, n_rho, variables, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(n, n_rho),
    values_from = cell
  )

false_table %>%
  kable(
    booktabs = TRUE,
    caption = "Bias (Coverage) for Noise Variables (X6–X20)",
    align = "lcccccc"
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(c(
    " " = 2,
    "n = 250" = 3,
    "n = 500" = 3
  )) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  pack_rows(index = table(false_table$method))
 
 

```



```{r, echo = F}
# Type I and Type II Errors
error_summary <- all_results %>%
  group_by(method, n, rho) %>%
  summarise(
    type_I_error = mean(signif[true_non_zero == 0]),
    type_II_error = 1 - mean(signif[true_non_zero == 1]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

library(ggplot2)

error_long <- error_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(type_I_error, type_II_error),
    names_to = "error_type",
    values_to = "rate"
  )
error_long$method <- factor(error_long$method,
                            levels = c("PVAL","AIC","BIC","LASSO_min","LASSO_1se","ENET_min","ENET_1se"))

ggplot(error_long,
       aes(x = method, y = rate, fill = error_type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(n ~ rho) +
  labs(
    title = "Type I and Type II Error Rates",
    y = "Error Rate",
    x = "Method",
    fill = "Error Type"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "type_I_error" = "darkolivegreen2",
    "type_II_error" = "cornflowerblue"
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

```
